title: A Court of Thorns and Roses Review: The Book That Ruined My Free Time
book: A Court of Thorns and Roses
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: The book that started my romantasy obsession! From my first read in June 2024 to three rereads and a slightly ridiculous Audible habit, here's why ACOTAR earned five stars and why I think it's the perfect introduction to fantasy romance. Includes a spoiler-filled discussion for those who've already fallen into Prythian.
author: Sarah J. Maas
